query: AMD embedded segment revenue Q2 2026 Xilinx FPGA
normalized: 2026 amd embedded fpga q2 revenue segment xilinx

output.content: AMD’s Embedded segment generated **$977 million of revenue in Q2 2026**, up **19% year over year** from **$824 million in Q2 2025** and up from **$873 million in Q1 2026**. AMD attributed the growth to strengthening demand across multiple end markets; the segment includes the company’s Xilinx-derived adaptive-computing/FPGA portfolio, although AMD did not separately disclose Xilinx FPGA-only revenue. [[1]]

sources.title: AMD Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results :: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD)
